items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: I worked with that man 18 years... He said, 'Come on and play one with me.' ... 'pack your bags we’re leaving in the morning.'

ctx.x: Do you recall who you were hearing at the time on the radio?

Well let’s see. I think Benny Goodman was probably — he was one of the top, I’d say top musicians playing. He wasn’t actually playing jazz though, he was playing swing, which, it sounded close to jazz. And I used to listen to his band you know, with Teddy Wilson playing piano. And he had that extra group, a sextet I think it was, and Lionel Hampton was in that group. And I mean it really excited me. You know I started talking about this, and well my mother and father, I have to confess they weren’t really into…
You’re going from Beethoven to Teddy Wilson, right?
